Summary.Name: DeepCORO-SCAD
Summary.Description: DeepCORO-CLIP based research model that estimates the study-level probability of spontaneous coronary artery dissection (SCAD) from up to four coronary angiography videos.

Mechanism.Outcome: Spontaneous coronary artery dissection (SCAD) on the diagnostic coronary angiogram
Mechanism.Output: SCAD probability (sigmoid of the scad head) and a SCAD-suspected flag at the validation-derived threshold of 0.0524. Auxiliary training heads (atherosclerotic CAD, other finding, stenosis) are not reported.
Mechanism.Target_population: Adults undergoing diagnostic coronary angiography represented by the model development cohort (Montreal Heart Institute plus SCAD cases from the UBC Vancouver SCAD registry and UBC partner sites)
Mechanism.Input_data_source: Coronary angiography study, up to four videos (ideally two left and two right coronary views), ordered by DICOM SeriesTime
Mechanism.Model_type: Deep Learning (MViT video encoder, 16 frames at 224 px, plus multiple-instance linear probing with mean pooling over four videos)

Performance.Held_out_test_all_sites: n=270 studies (56 SCAD): AUROC 0.95 (95% CI 0.91-0.97), sensitivity 0.91, specificity 0.84, NPV 0.97
Performance.Held_out_test_Montreal_Heart_Institute: n=229 studies: AUROC 0.87 (95% CI 0.78-0.94), sensitivity 0.69, specificity 0.85, NPV 0.97
Performance.Threshold: 0.0524, fixed on the validation set to favour sensitivity

Uses_and_directions.General_use: Research and demonstration of angiography-based SCAD detection.
Uses_and_directions.Directions: Submit one diagnostic XA study with up to four videos, preferably two left and two right coronary views. Interpret the output as a model score, not a calibrated clinical probability.
Uses_and_directions.Not_intended_use: Diagnosis, ruling out SCAD, lesion localisation, or changing treatment or revascularization decisions.

Warnings_and_limitations.Research_only: No regulatory clearance. The model and its threshold are not validated for clinical decision-making.
Warnings_and_limitations.Site_confounding: External sites contributed SCAD-positive studies only, so the all-sites estimate can be inflated by site differences. The single-site Montreal Heart Institute estimate is lower (AUROC 0.87, sensitivity 0.69).
Warnings_and_limitations.Localisation: The model gives one study-level output and does not localise the dissected segment.
Warnings_and_limitations.Calibration: The displayed probability is a sigmoid output and is not a calibrated absolute risk. A result below the threshold does not exclude SCAD.
Warnings_and_limitations.Input_selection: The service uses at most the first four processable videos after ordering by DICOM SeriesTime; additional videos are ignored and missing slots are masked out of the mean pooling.

Artifact_provenance.Checkpoint_heads: Four heads (scad, cad, other, stenosis) under the linear_probing state-dict key; only scad is reported

Résumé.Description: Modèle de recherche fondé sur DeepCORO-CLIP qui estime, à l'échelle de l'examen, la probabilité de dissection coronarienne spontanée (DCS) à partir d'au plus quatre vidéos de coronarographie.

Performance.Test_tous_sites: n=270 examens (56 DCS) : ASC 0,95 (IC 95 % 0,91-0,97), sensibilité 0,91, spécificité 0,84, VPN 0,97
Performance.Test_Institut_de_Cardiologie_de_Montréal: n=229 examens : ASC 0,87 (IC 95 % 0,78-0,94), sensibilité 0,69, spécificité 0,85, VPN 0,97

Avertissements.Recherche_uniquement: Aucune autorisation réglementaire. Le modèle et son seuil ne sont pas validés pour la prise de décision clinique.
Avertissements.Confusion_par_site: Les sites externes n'ont fourni que des examens avec DCS ; l'estimation tous sites peut donc être surestimée par les différences entre sites.
Avertissements.Localisation: Le modèle produit un seul résultat par examen et ne localise pas le segment disséqué.
Avertissements.Interprétation: La probabilité affichée n'est pas un risque absolu étalonné. Un résultat sous le seuil n'exclut pas une DCS.
